descriptions.value:
A vulnerability has been identified in SCALANCE LPE9403 (6GK5998-3GS00-2AC2) (All versions < V2.1 HF0 with SINEMA Remote Connect Edge Client installed). Affected devices do not properly sanitize configuration parameters.
This could allow a non-privileged local attacker to execute root commands on the device.

descriptions.description: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

kev_metadata.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Windows if the Windows Secondary Logon Service fails to properly manage request handles in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run arbitrary code as an administrator.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Secondary Logon Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability

title: Microsoft Windows Secondary Logon Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability

kev_metadata.notes: This vulnerability affects a common open-source component, third-party library, or a protocol used by different products. For more information, please see: https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/torvalds/linux.git/commit/?id=a87938b2e246b81b4fb713edb371a9fa3c5c3c86; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2017-1000253
kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Linux kernel contains a position-independent executable (PIE) stack buffer corruption vulnerability in load_elf_ binary() that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel PIE Stack Buffer Corruption Vulnerability

title: Linux Kernel PIE Stack Buffer Corruption Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the Virtual Private LAN Service (VPLS) code of Cisco IOS for Cisco Catalyst 6800 Series Switches could allow an unauthenticated, adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst 6800 Series Switches VPLS Denial-of-Service Vulnerability

title: Cisco Catalyst 6800 Series Switches VPLS Denial-of-Service Vulnerability

kev_metadata.requiredAction: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Dasan GPON Routers contain an authentication bypass vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2018-10562, exploitation can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Dasan GPON Routers Authentication Bypass Vulnerability

title: Dasan GPON Routers Authentication Bypass Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: DotNetNuke (DNN) contains an inadequate encryption strength vulnerability resulting from the use of a weak encryption algorithm to protect input parameters.

kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services contains a deserialization vulnerability when handling page requests incorrectly. An authenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the Report Server service account.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

title: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that may allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Code Execution Vulnerability

title: Apple Multiple Products Code Execution Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: A type confusion issue affecting multiple Apple products allows processing of maliciously crafted web content, leading to arbitrary code execution.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Type Confusion Vulnerability

title: Apple Multiple Products Type Confusion Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Samsung mobile devices using Mali GPU contain an incorrect implementation handling file descriptor in dpu driver. This incorrect implementation results in memory corruption, leading to kernel panic. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2021-25337 and CVE-2021-25369.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Samsung Mobile Devices Memory Corruption Vulnerability

title: Samsung Mobile Devices Memory Corruption Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Aviatrix Controllers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. Shell metacharacters can be sent to /v1/api in cloud_type for list_flightpath_destination_instances, or src_cloud_type for flightpath_connection_test.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Aviatrix Controllers OS Command Injection Vulnerability

title: Aviatrix Controllers OS Command Injection Vulnerability

kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
